data.gender_notes: Bahja is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bahja is an Arabic name that symbolizes beauty, radiance, and elegance. It is a popular name in Islamic cultures, representing the beauty of the soul. The name Bahja carries the meaning “Beauty and Radiance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahja usually hope their child will grow to embody beauty and radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Bahja is associated with the concept of inner beauty and spiritual radiance, reflecting the divine light of Allah.
data.etymology: Bahja belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beauty and Radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahja total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: بهجة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بهجة هي كلمة عربية تعني الفرح والسرور والبهجة، وتستخدم في اللغة العربية لوصف الشعور بالسعادة والرضا، وتُستخدم أيضا في القرآن الكريم في سياق وصف الجنة والجنات، وتحمل هذه الكلمة معنى روحانيا عميقا في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: بہجہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: بہجہ ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب خوشی اور مسرت ہے، اور اسے اسلام میں روحانی خوشی اور سکون کے معنوں سے بھی جوڑا جاتا ہے، یہ نام برصغیر پاک و ہند میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان بہت مقبول ہے

in_hindi.name: बह्जा
